mapper.select: INSERT INTO task (type, payload, priority, dedup_key, run_after) VALUES (#{type}, #{payload, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.type.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{priority, typeHandler=org.catalogueoflife.nametracker.store.task.TaskPriorityTypeHandler}, #{dedupKey}, COALESCE(#{runAfter, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, now())) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) WHERE state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT id FROM task WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')

UPDATE task SET state = 'RUNNING', locked_by = #{workerId}, locked_at = now(), started = now(), attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM task WHERE state = 'QUEUED' AND run_after <= now() AND type IN #{t} ORDER BY priority, run_after, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING *
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET state = 'DONE', finished = now(), locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND attempts = #{attempt}

UPDATE task SET last_error = #{error}, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL, state = CASE WHEN attempts < #{maxAttempts} THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE 'DEAD' END, finished = CASE WHEN attempts < #{maxAttempts} THEN NULL ELSE now() END, run_after = CASE WHEN attempts < #{maxAttempts} THEN now() + make_interval(secs => #{backoffSeconds} * power(2, LEAST(attempts - 1, 16))) ELSE run_after END WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND attempts = #{attempt}
UPDATE task SET locked_at = now() WHERE state = 'RUNNING' AND id IN #{i}

UPDATE task SET state = CASE WHEN attempts >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'QUEUED' END, last_error = CASE WHEN attempts >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'worker died during attempt ' || attempts ELSE last_error END, finished = CASE WHEN attempts >= #{maxAttempts} THEN now() ELSE finished END, locked_by = NULL, locked_at = NULL WHERE state = 'RUNNING'
AND locked_at < now() - make_interval(secs => #{lockedLongerThanSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM task GROUP BY state
SELECT count(*) FROM task WHERE type = #{type} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND payload->>'window' = #{window}
SELECT type, state, count(*) AS n FROM task GROUP BY type, state ORDER BY type, state
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task WHERE state = 'DONE' AND finished < now() - make_interval(secs => #{olderThanSeconds})
